body.statement: For \(q,q'\in\mathcal Q\) and \(r,r'\in\mathcal R\), a common Poisson construction satisfies \(W_1(\mathcal L(Z_{r,q}),\mathcal L(Z_{r',q'}))\le(2K/c+1)\|r-r'\|_{\infty}+(4KB/c^2+2B/c)\|q-q'\|_{\infty}\); consequently the corresponding ramp risks differ by at most this bound divided by \(h_n\).
body.justification: This quantitative continuity makes exhaustive profile nets and directed convolution a finite certificate rather than a compactness assertion.
body.gap: Classical compound-Poisson Stein bounds do not provide this near-zero real signed-mark profile metric in the logged adaptive calibration problem.
body.consumer: The bound allocates profile discretization error and yields a terminating certification mesh.
